name: Hoarfrost Soup
desc: Vesna's specialty. Very carefully, she places an exquisite Prime Ice Construct into the pot before proudly declaring that she's making a "Secret Vila Snow Flurry Soup." Anyone who'd like a taste, she says, is welcome to add whatever ingredients they fancy. Tempted by the prospect of savoring a little more of the broth, Paimon eagerly parts with every ingredient you've just spent all day collecting. By the time the "secret soup" is ready, you see that it's made entirely from the ingredients Paimon just contributed... though Vesna is the one who ends up eating most of it.

value.text: Increases all party members' DEF by 282 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
